Quick list of parking-lot questions I want to surface so we can prioritize in the call (will forward to Samantha once we agree):

1) Expected RPS / token throughput for the first 90 days + steady-state (helpful to size dedicated pools).
2) Typical sequence lengths / max context windows we should expect (KV cache behavior).
3) Data residency & network path: any restrictions on outbound connections from your VPC (eg. egress to our hosted control plane)?

Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers ahead of the main session:

1) Expected RPS: initial pilot ~20 req/s (avg payload), ramp to 75–100 req/s over 90 days.
2) Sequence lengths: median ~256 tokens, peak up to ~4k tokens for multi-turn context.
3) Network: we do not allow unexpected outbound egress from our production VPC; all egress must go through our NAT + approved IP ranges. We can share the allowed egress list prior to the call.
4) KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys (AWS KMS).
5) Failover: must have graceful degradation — auto-fallback to a quantized smaller model is acceptable but only after explicit alerting and a manual confirmation window.
6) Monitoring: we need token-level latency breakdowns for first byte/ last byte and span-level traces correlated to request IDs.

We can do the 12:45–1:00pm PT pre-call with Michael and our infra engineer (I’ll add them to the calendar invite). 45 minutes for the main session is fine; please keep the walkthrough focused on deployment and failover patterns and we’ll save billing/credits for a follow-up.

I’ve uploaded our allowed-egress CIDR list to a shared folder and will post the link here before the call.

See you Wed —
Samantha
